name: IconButton
summary: Icon-only button with a required accessible label.

a11y.keyboardNote: Measured in a browser on 27/08/2026. Both confirmed: it is a real <button>, and the platform delivers the two keys. The bank needs a handler with an observable effect — a button whose onClick does nothing reads as an inert key in a DOM snapshot, which is a limitation of the method and not of the component.

props.name: label
props.description: REQUIRED. Becomes aria-label: an icon with no text has no accessible name without it.

props.name: icon
props.description: Glyph, from the contract's allowlist — or the app's own drawing (a component that returns its <svg>), as Icon and the native IconButton take.

props.name: variant
props.description: Same variants as Button. Ghost by default, so a row of them stays quiet. `secondary` is the neutral fill with the brand-coloured label; `tertiary` the neutral fill with the plain label (the default).

props.name: appearance
props.type: solid | outline | ghost | link | nav | soft
props.description: Inherited from Button. How much weight the box carries; the default here is ghost.

props.name: tone
props.type: neutral | brand | danger | success | warning | info
props.description: Inherited from Button. What the colour means; every combination exists.

props.name: size
props.description: Square target: the width follows the same density token as the height.

props.name: loading
props.description: Spinner in place of the glyph, aria-busy set, interaction blocked.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders an anchor with the same skin, like Button.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: A second glyph before the main one. Rare on an icon button, and it is here because the type is shared with Button.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: A glyph after the main one — a chevron on a button that opens a menu, for instance.

props.name: kbd
props.description: Shows the shortcut inside the button AND announces it with aria-keyshortcuts. Showing it without announcing would be decoration. A list (["Ctrl", "K"]) shows one key cap per key and announces the combination (Control+K).

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Fills the width of the container instead of hugging the glyph.

props.name: grow
props.description: In a row (Cluster), takes an equal share with the other buttons that also grow. `fullWidth` asks for the whole line instead.

props.name: target
props.description: Link attribute, only with `href`.

props.name: rel
props.description: Link attribute, only with `href`.

props.name: download
props.description: Link attribute, only with `href`.

props.name: render
props.description: The element drawn instead of the <button>/<a> — your router's link, e.g. render={<Link href="/reports" />}. It receives the button's skin, content (icons, label, shortcut) and attributes; the destination is its own. Disabled or loading, its click is blocked too, like the disabled link.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Deprecated, removed in 1.0: paints and announces aria-pressed while YOU keep the state. Use Toggle, which keeps the state and demands an accessible name when it is icon-only.

props.name: share
props.type: { url?: string; title?: string; text?: string }
props.description: The button shares. It asks the browser whether it can share this link (navigator.canShare) — detecting the capability, not guessing the device. If it can (phones; Chrome, Edge and Safari on desktop), the device's share sheet opens, and cancelling is not an error. If it cannot, it copies the link and shows "Link copied" anchored to the button, at the button's size. If the copy fails, it says so and shows the link selected. The notice speaks to the screen reader. Without url, it is the page's address. Needs the AureaProvider (or aurea.js on the page) to give the notice; it emits [data-aurea-share], which aurea.js also reads. Only on a <button> (ignored with href or render). On native, the same name opens the system share sheet.

props.name: quiet
props.description: Less weight: muted text one step smaller — the Button's quiet.
